detailed_description: The .htaccess Generator creates a starter Apache .htaccess snippet from a small browser form. Toggle URL options for forcing HTTPS, forcing www, or removing www, enable gzip and browser caching, optionally block image hotlinking, add custom 404/500 error pages, paste one blocked IP or CIDR entry per line, and paste simple redirect pairs such as /old-page /new-page. Click Generate to build the output textarea and Copy to copy it. The generated text also includes basic security headers, disabled directory browsing, and .htaccess file protection. The tool does not choose an Apache version, validate syntax, generate htpasswd files, download files, inspect server modules, or guarantee production-ready compatibility.
usage_steps: Choose URL handling checkboxes such as Force HTTPS, Force WWW, or Remove WWW
Toggle gzip, browser caching, and optional hotlink blocking
Optionally enable custom error pages and enter 404/500 paths
Paste blocked IP addresses or CIDR ranges, one per line, and simple redirect pairs if needed
Click Generate to create the .htaccess snippet
Review the output manually, then click Copy when you want to reuse it
usage_examples: Create a starter snippet that redirects HTTP traffic to HTTPS
Generate browser caching and gzip rules for common static asset types
Add basic 404 and 500 ErrorDocument paths to a small site
Turn a short list of old and new paths into simple 301 Redirect lines
